learning_objective: 🎯 Become a nature detective by exploring, identifying, and recording the amazing plants, birds, and insects living right in your neighborhood!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Biodiversity is the wonderful variety of life on Earth! It includes every tiny bug, tall tree, chirping bird, and even you, all living together like a giant family.
To make a register, you have to look closely at nature. Use a magnifying glass or just your eyes to carefully watch how ants move or what color the local flowers are.
A biodiversity register is your special notebook where you draw pictures and write down facts about the plants and animals you find. It helps scientists protect our beautiful environment!

fun_activity.title: 🍃 The Leaf Safari
fun_activity.instructions: Go to your garden or a nearby park and safely collect 3 leaves of different shapes. Paste them in your notebook and write down the name of the plant if you know it!

quick_recap: ⭐ Biodiversity means the beautiful mix of all living things around us.
⭐ We can learn so much just by quietly observing nature in our own backyard.
⭐ Keeping a record helps us understand and protect our local environment.
